description: Open source repositories that are in scope for active bug bounty programs, ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: ClickHouse/ClickHouse
repos.description: Apache-2.0 licensed, column-oriented OLAP database management system written in C++ for real-time analytical reporting over SQL. In scope for the public ClickHouse bug bounty program on Bugcrowd (open, rewards $50-$2,500, full safe harbour), which lists https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse as an in-scope target in its own right, separate from the ClickHouse Cloud target; the repository's own SECURITY.md directs reports to that Bugcrowd program "and be rewarded for it", and the 26.6 line is listed as a supported version. Latest stable release: v26.6.2.158-stable (2026-08-04, 15:22 UTC).

repos.name: justeattakeaway/pie
repos.description: PIE (Principles for Interfaces and Experiences), Just Eat Takeaway.com's Apache-2.0 licensed open source design system: a TypeScript monorepo publishing Web Component packages under the @justeattakeaway npm scope. In scope for the Just Eat Takeaway.com bug bounty program on Bugcrowd (open, $100-$4,500) through the org-wide in-scope asset https://github.com/justeattakeaway in the "Source code and supply chain" group, which carries its own reward range of P1 $1,500-$2,500, P2 $700-$1,000, P3 $100-$300; that group rewards supply chain, GitHub Actions and credential leakage findings rather than code-level bugs in the repository. Latest stable release: @justeattakeaway/pie-notification@0.24.12 (2026-08-04, 13:10 UTC).

repos.name: elastic/beats
repos.description: Lightweight Go data shippers (Filebeat, Metricbeat, Packetbeat, Auditbeat, Heartbeat, Winlogbeat, Osquerybeat) that send logs, metrics and network data to the Elastic Stack; source outside the x-pack folder is Apache-2.0 licensed. In scope for the Elastic bug bounty program on HackerOne, which lists a "Beats" asset naming https://github.com/elastic/beats plus per-Beat assets for each shipper, all eligible for bounty at critical maximum severity, conditioned on testing a currently supported version. Latest stable release: 9.5.0 (2026-08-04, 12:36 UTC).
